patch_description:
This crossover retains the unit-square hull and fixed corners from the current program, preserving an exactly unit convex-hull area and the original function interface. It incorporates the stronger inspiration program’s bundle-style coordinate search, exact bottleneck-gradient proposals, batched incident-triangle evaluation, soft lower-tail tie-breaking, and targeted joint moves for tight triangles.

The implementation is more efficient than repeatedly recomputing all triangle determinants for every single proposal: coordinate proposals update only triangles incident to the moved point. Full batch evaluation is used only for occasional two-point escape moves. Fixed seeding and a defensive fallback preserve deterministic, reproducible behavior.
